item.title: Solving the Generalized Sylvester Equation
item.description:
Solving the Generalized Sylvester Equation

Author: Jingmengzhiyue()

Solving the Generalized Sylvester Equation

Common Sylvester Equations

The Sylvester equation

$$ \mathbf{AX}+\mathbf{XD} = \mathbf{E} $$

The generalized Sylvester equation

$$ \mathbf{AXB}+\mathbf{CXD} = \mathbf{E} $$

where $\mathbf{X}\in \mathbb{R}^{n\times r}$, $\mathbf{A}\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, $\mathbf{B}\in \mathbb{R}^{r\times p}$, $\mathbf{C}\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, $\mathbf{D}\in \mathbb{R}^{r\times p}$, $\mathbf{E}\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times p}$.

The Stein matrix equation

$$ \mathbf{AXB}+\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{E} $$

The Lyapunov matrix equation

$$ \mathbf{AX}+\mathbf{XA^T}=\mathbf{E} $$

Solving the Generalized Sylvester Equation

  1. Use a closed-form solution
  2. Use Newton’s method or the conjugate gradient method

Solving the Generalized Sylvester Equation with ADMM
